name: Rotisserie Chicken and Dumplings
desc: Creamy chicken soup made with rotisserie chicken and small fluffy drop dumplings.

source.title: Rotisserie Chicken & Dumplings
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 3 cups shredded rotisserie chicken (about 1 chicken, skin and bones removed)
ingredients.note: about 1 chicken, skin and bones removed

ingredients.raw: Kosher salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Melt the butter in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Sweat the carrot, onion and celery 6-8 min, stirring, until softened but not browned.
Add the broth and cream and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the shredded chicken and season with salt and pepper.
Make the dumplings: whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt. Cut in the butter with a pastry cutter or two forks until crumbly, then stir in the warm milk only until combined.

With the soup at a gentle simmer, drop in small spoonfuls of dough (about 1 tsp each). Cover and simmer 15 min without lifting the lid, until the dumplings float, have puffed, and are cooked through with no raw dough in the center.
Taste for salt and pepper and serve.
tips: For a shortcut, cut a can of refrigerated biscuits into small pieces and drop those in instead; simmer until cooked through.
Keep the soup at a gentle simmer once the dumplings go in; a hard boil breaks them apart.

references.title: Chicken and Dumplings With Rotisserie Chicken
